## Checklist

- [ ] No weights, indexes, optimizer states, private accounts, credentials or real private conversations.
- [ ] Record-level data is reviewed/approved for this repository; synthetic status alone is not approval.
- [ ] Notebook outputs are cleared; portable paths and dependencies are documented.
- [ ] Metrics include sample counts, failures and limitations; no invented results.
- [ ] Component README links the uploaded work and honestly identifies what is missing.
- [ ] No unannounced change to the selected application under nora/.

The existing application CI is not a privacy/license review of this research upload.
